acceptable_paraphrases: a three-dimensional shape with twelve sides
a polyhedron with six surfaces and twelve edges
an object with a dozen edges and half a dozen faces
critical_errors: polytope with more or fewer than 12 edges
misconceptions: assuming a shape cannot have both 12 edges and 6 faces
believing only the cube or cuboid meet the criteria
grading_notes: A polyhedron with 12 edges can be considered as having six square and/or rectangular lateral faces (not counting the bases), and two base faces, each of which is a polygon (such as rectangle or hexagon) but not necessarily equal in number of sides to the number of edges.
